The sample of the load profile from the SHS using a customer is i) laptop computer 2 numbers, each 20 watt, daily operation 3 hours, ii) electric lamp 4 numbers, each 30 watt, daily operation 8 hours, iii) colour television 2 numbers, each 50 watt, daily operation 6 hours, iv) gizer 1 number of 800 watt, daily operation 2 hours. The system inverter power factor is unity, DOD = 60%, autonomy days is 4, battery charging efficiency is 75%, peak sun hours daily is 5, battery voltage is 12 V.
Using the above mentioned data, design a PV module. Also, calculate (i) battery capacity, (ii) charge controller capacity, (iii) DC to AC inverter capacity, (iv) switch capacity, and (v) wire size.
